query:
UPDATE classification_days SET
            counted         = $3,
            suspect         = $4,
            no_data         = $5,
            ruleset_id      = $6,
            classified_at   = NOW(),
            claimed_at      = NULL,
            attempts        = 0,
            last_error      = NULL,
            dirty           = (dirty_gen <> $7),
            next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN dirty_gen <> $7 THEN NOW() ELSE next_attempt_at END
        WHERE user_id = $1 AND day = $2
        RETURNING NOT dirty AS "clean!"
